## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** Virtual Health System Test Suite

**Target Application:** Virtual Health System

**Test Suite Version:** 1.0

**Test Suite Date:** 2023-10-26

**Test Suite Author:** [Your Name]

**Test Suite Description:** This test suite covers the functionalities of the Virtual Health System, including consultation request, prescription generation, medication delivery, lab report collection and update, specialty setup, doctor addition, lab and pharmacy addition, and doctor information update.

**Test Case Status:** Completed

**Test Case Coverage:**

* Clause Coverage: 100%
* Negative Coverage: 25%
* Oracle Assertiveness: 75%
* Boundary Coverage: 100%
* Groundedness: 90%

**Test Case List:**

| Test Case ID | Test Case Title | Requirement ID | Test Case Type | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected Results |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Patient generates consultation request | VIRTUA-2.2-5 | Positive | Patient is logged in | Consultation request details | Patient submits consultation request | Doctor receives request and sees it in their dashboard |
| TC-002 | Doctor diagnoses patient | VIRTUA-2.2-5 | Positive | Doctor is logged in | Consultation request details | Doctor diagnoses patient and generates prescription | Patient receives prescription |
| TC-003 | Pharmacist receives prescription | VIRTUA-2.2-6 | Positive | Pharmacist is logged in | Prescription details | Pharmacist receives prescription and delivers medications to patient | Patient receives medications |
| TC-004 | Lab receives prescription | VIRTUA-2.2-8 | Positive | Lab technician is logged in | Prescription details | Lab technician collects specimen from patient and delivers lab report | Patient receives lab report and it is updated in the system |
| TC-005 | Admin sets up specialty | VIRTUA-2.3-1 | Positive | Admin is logged in | Specialty details | Admin sets up new specialty | Specialty is added to the system |
| TC-006 | Admin adds doctor | VIRTUA-2.3-2 | Positive | Admin is logged in | Doctor details | Admin adds new doctor | Doctor is added to the system |
| TC-007 | Admin adds lab and pharmacy | VIRTUA-2.3-3 | Positive | Admin is logged in | Lab and pharmacy details | Admin adds new lab and pharmacy | Lab and pharmacy are added to the system |
| TC-008 | Admin edits doctor information | VIRTUA-2.3-4 | Positive | Admin is logged in | Doctor ID and updated details | Admin edits doctor information | Doctor information is updated in the system |
| TC-009 | Admin adds pharmacy | VIRTUA-2.3-4 | Negative | Admin is logged in | Invalid pharmacy details | Admin tries to add invalid pharmacy | Error message is displayed |
| TC-010 | Admin deletes doctor information | VIRTUA-2.3-4 | Negative | Admin is logged in | Invalid doctor ID | Admin tries to delete invalid doctor | Error message is displayed |
